```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<p>H<sub>2</sub>O and E=mc<sup>2</sup></p>");
var_dump($result);
```
